These are Sharpe ratios <i>implied by the price targets</i>, not measured ones. Recalculated with every price update.</div>

  <h2>Current Best Buy</h2>
  <label class="pp-tog"><input type="checkbox" id="pp-on" checked> Include personal predictions <span>(50% weight on BTC, SOL, TSLA and MSTR 2030 targets; untick to see every ranking, pick and optimal mix on outside forecasts only)</span></label>
  <div class="pp-stat" id="pp-stat"></div>
  <div class="fdpager">
  <div class="best pg" data-t="Comparative Value">
    <h3>Comparative Value<span>which asset is most beaten down against its own history</span></h3>
    <div class="best-sub">Every asset scored for deepest value: largest negative deviation to its 20-week EMA &amp; 200-day EMA, measured in its own typical swings (z-score) so volatile assets aren't automatically the cheapest. Those further from ATH also rank higher. Updates with every price refresh.</div>
    <div class="best-chart"><canvas id="cv-chart"></canvas></div>
    <details class="srcs"><summary>Formulas (click to open)</summary><div class="fbody">
      <p><b>Gaps:</b> <code>g₂₀w = ln(Price ÷ EMA₂₀w)</code> and <code>g₂₀₀d = ln(Price ÷ EMA₂₀₀d)</code>, with <code>EMAₜ = α·xₜ + (1 − α)·EMAₜ₋₁</code>, α = 2/21 on weekly closes and 2/201 on daily closes.</p>
      <p><b>Volatility-adjusted (z-score):</b> <code>z = g ÷ standard deviation of g over the last ~2 years (520 trading days)</code>. A −10% gap is a big deal for SPY (≈ −2σ) but routine for a SOL treasury stock (≈ −0.5σ).</p>
      <p><b>ATH bonus:</b> <code>DD = 1 − Price ÷ ATH</code> (highest close since 2016; treasury companies only since they started holding coins).</p>
      <p><b>Value score (bar):</b> <code>−(z₂₀w + z₂₀₀d) ÷ 2 + 0.75 × DD</code>. Higher = cheaper. Assets need 30 days of history.</p>
    </div></details>
  </div>
  <div class="best pg" data-t="Fair Value">
    <h3>Fair Value<span>where each asset sits vs its own long-term log regression trend</span></h3>
    <div class="best-sub">Each asset's whole price history is fit to a logarithmic regression trendline (the "fair value" line). Bars show how far today's price is above or below that line; the most undervalued is on top. Below, the same averaged by asset class. Updates with every price refresh.</div>
    <div class="best-chart"><canvas id="fv-chart"></canvas></div>
    <div class="fv-detail"><div class="fv-t">By asset class <span id="fv-class-now"></span></div><div class="fv-c"><canvas id="fv-class"></canvas></div></div>
    <details class="srcs"><summary>Formulas (click to open)</summary><div class="fbody">
      <p><b>Trendline:</b> <code>ln(Price) = a + b × ln(days since the asset began)</code>, fit by least squares on weekly closes over all available history (a power-law, the same kind of log regression used for bitcoin). "Began" = launch or listing date (bitcoin: the Jan 3, 2009 genesis block; treasury companies: the day they started holding coins).</p>
      <p><b>Fair value</b> = the trendline today: <code>e^(a + b × ln(days))</code> · <b>Bar</b> = <code>Price ÷ Fair value − 1</code> · <b>σ</b> = how far that is in standard deviations of the asset's own history around the line (−2σ = rarely this cheap).</p>
      <p><b>By asset class:</b> for AI, Crypto and Commodities, each member's distance from its own trendline is averaged every week (in log terms, members with 2+ years of prices), so 0% = the class as a whole sits on fair value.</p>
      <p>Needs at least 2 years of prices to fit a trend, so the newer treasury companies and SPCX aren't shown. A trendline describes the past; it isn't a forecast.</p>
    </div></details>
  </div>
  <div class="best pg" data-t="Projected Growth">
    <h3>Projected Growth<span>today's price vs the forecasters' 2030 targets</span></h3>
    <div class="best-sub">Ranked by average 2030 return (today's price to the median 2030 target). Bars show that return as a CAGR (yearly compound growth) so big and small numbers fit on one chart.</div>
    <div class="best-chart"><canvas id="best-chart"></canvas></div>
    <div class="fv-detail"><div class="fv-t">By asset class <span id="pg-class-now"></span></div><div class="fv-c"><canvas id="pg-class"></canvas></div></div>
    <div class="best-wrap"><table id="best-table"><thead>
      <tr class="grp"><th colspan="2"></th><th colspan="4" class="g1">Value signals</th><th colspan="7" class="g1">Price targets</th></tr>
      <tr><th>Ticker</th><th>Price</th><th class="g1">Below ATH</th><th>vs 20-wk EMA</th><th>vs 200-day EMA</th><th>Value score</th><th class="g1">Low target</th><th>Median target</th><th>High target</th><th>12-mo return</th><th>At NAV 1.0x</th><th>CAGR to 2030</th><th>Return to 2030 median</th></tr>
    </thead><tbody></tbody></table></div>
    <div class="best-method" id="best-method"></div>
    <details class="srcs"><summary>Formulas (click to open)</summary><div class="fbody">
      <p><b>Targets:</b> Low / High = lowest / highest 2030 target. Median = median of all 2030 targets, except BTC, SOL, TSLA, MSTR: <code>0.5 × Personal predictions + 0.5 × average of the others</code>.</p>
      <p><b>Conversions:</b> SLV, CPER <code>= metal target × ETF price ÷ metal price today</code> · SPY <code>= S&amp;P 500 target ÷ 10.02</code> · copper <code>$/lb = $/t ÷ 2,204.62</code> · UUUU, SILJ, MP <code>= price on the target date × sector 2030 target ÷ sector price on that date</code> (uranium, silver, avg of uranium/silver/gold/copper), locked in dollars.</p>
      <p><b>Treasury companies:</b> <code>CPS = coins ÷ shares</code> · <code>mNAV = Price ÷ (CPS × coin price)</code> · <code>Target = coin 2030 target × CPS × √mNAV</code> (NAV assumed halfway back to 1.0x) · At NAV 1.0x <code>= Price ÷ CPS</code> and <code>CPS × coin median target</code>.</p>
      <p><b>12-month return:</b> each ~1-year target is restated to exactly 12 months from today: if it's further out, <code>Price × (Target ÷ Price)^(12 ÷ months)</code>; if it's sooner, it's carried forward along the path to the median 2030 target. Expired targets are dropped. Stocks use the analyst consensus (12 months from its date).</p>
      <p><b>By asset class:</b> the average CAGR to the median 2030 target of each bucket's members, every week since March 2020, using that week's price and years left to 2030. It uses today's targets for past weeks, so read it as "how much upside the current targets implied at that week's price."</p>
      <p><b>Returns:</b> <code>Return to 2030 median = Median ÷ Price − 1</code> (ranking) · <code>CAGR = (Median ÷ Price)^(1/Y) − 1</code>, Y = years to Dec 31, 2030 (bar) · <b>Colors:</b> yellow → green by rank; faded red = negative.</p>
    </div></details>
    <details class="srcs"><summary>Sources for every price target (click to open)</summary>
      <p class="note">Every forecaster behind the low, median and high targets, with the date it was published and a link. Targets checked <span id="tgt-asof"></span>. To add your own 2030 target for any asset, set it in <code>USER_INPUT</code> at the top of the targets section in <code>scripts/update_market_data.py</code>; it then counts as one more source.</p>
      <div class="body" id="best-sources"></div></details>
  </div>
  </div>
  <h2>BTC and Solana Treasury Companies</h2>
  <div class="tre">
    <div class="tre-top"><div><span class="k">BTC</span> <b id="tre-btc">…</b></div><div><span class="k">SOL</span> <b id="tre-sol">…</b></div><div><span class="k">BTC market cap</span> <b id="tre-mcap">…</b></div><div class="tre-note">Ranked best buy first by the last column. Green = below 1 (stock is cheaper than its coins), red = above 1. Click a column to re-sort.</div></div>
    <div class="tre-wrap"><table id="tre-table"><thead><tr>
      <th data-s="t">Ticker</th><th data-s="coin">Coin</th><th data-s="price">Share Price</th><th data-s="mcap">Market Cap</th>
      <th data-s="qty" class="b">HOLD QTY</th><th data-s="hold" class="b">HOLD $</th><th data-s="per" class="b">Crypto Per $ Invested</th><th data-s="nav" class="b">mNAV (equity only)</th><th data-s="navd" class="b">mNAV incl. Debt</th><th data-s="navt" class="b">mNAV at 1st Target incl. Debt</th><th data-s="cvn" class="b">Notes Converting at 1st Target</th><th data-s="fin" class="b t1">Final: mNAV at 1st Target, Debt + Conversions</th>
    </tr></thead><tbody></tbody></table></div>
    <div class="tre-foot">Crypto per $ invested = BTC or SOL held ÷ market cap. mNAV (equity only) = market cap ÷ crypto held. n/m = not meaningful for Tesla and SpaceX, operating companies whose coins are a tiny part of their value. Coin holdings from CoinGecko's public treasury data and share counts from Yahoo Finance, both refreshed monthly (last <span id="tre-asof"></span><span id="tre-solasof" style="display:none"></span>). Share prices from Yahoo Finance (about every 2 hours); BTC and SOL live from Coinbase. Market caps count only shares. <b>mNAV incl. debt</b> = (market cap + debt + preferred &minus; cash) &divide; crypto held: enterprise value per dollar of coins, i.e. what you really pay for the coins once lenders and preferred holders are paid. HOLD QTY is net of coins owed back (DeFi Development's borrowed SOL, and Upexi&#39;s 1.08M SOL set aside to hand back to noteholders). Debt, preferred and cash from each company's latest filing (mostly June 30, 2026; Strategy Aug/Sep 2026); hover a cell for the breakdown.<br><br><b>The three forward columns</b> use each coin&#39;s first price target, the average of its near-term (12-month to end-2027) forecasts in the Current Best Buy sources: <span id="tre-t1"></span>.<br>
      <b>mNAV at 1st target incl. debt</b> = market cap &divide; (net coins &times; first target &minus; debt &minus; preferred + cash). All convertible notes are treated as debt (Upexi&#39;s as SOL handed back).<br>
      <b>Notes converting at 1st target</b>: a note converts when the shares it turns into are worth more than what its holder gets otherwise (the dollar principal, or for Upexi the SOL returned). Converted notes leave the debt and add shares. Strategy&#39;s STRK and Metaplanet&#39;s MERCURY preferred are treated the same way.<br>
      <b>Final</b> = share price &divide; (value left for shareholders at the first target &divide; shares after conversions). Below 1 = the stock is cheap even after every lender is paid and every in-the-money note converts. Holdings, shares (including pre-funded and penny warrants), debt and converts from each company&#39;s latest filing or press release (Sept 2026; Upexi and DeFi Development June 30); hover for the math.</div>
  </div>
  <h2>This Week's Best Buys</h2>
  <div class="picks"><div class="row" id="picks-row"><span class="tk">…</span></div>
    <div class="meta" id="picks-meta">Top 10 by combined rank in Comparative Value and Projected Growth · recalculated with every price refresh</div></div>
  <details class="srcs picks-f"><summary>Formula (click to open)</summary><div class="fbody">
    <p>Each asset gets two ranks, turned into a 0–100 score (100 = 1st place): <b>Value</b> = its place on the Comparative Value chart, <b>Growth</b> = its place on the Projected Growth chart (avg 2030 return).</p>
    <p><code>Overall = (Value score + Growth score) ÷ 2</code>. The ten highest overall are shown; ties go to the higher Growth score. The backtests buy the top 5.</p>
  </div></details>
  <br><br><br><br><br>
  <h2>Backtests</h2>
  <div class="bt-sub">$7,000 a year into a Roth IRA, invested every Monday since March 2020</div>
  <div class="bt-exp">Four plans, each against the S&amp;P 500 bought the same way: a 40/40/20 bitcoin / S&amp;P / gold mix and an equal split across every ticker (both bought and held), the equal split with a basic layer-out rule on each asset&#39;s regression line, and a ⅓ uranium / ⅓ silver / ⅓ bitcoin mix (bought and held). All four use prices only, no price targets, so there is no hindsight in the picks.</div>
  <details class="srcs picks-f"><summary>Backtest formulas, stats &amp; limits (click to open)</summary><div class="fbody">
    <p><b>Weekly buying:</b> each Monday's $135 is split by the plan's fixed weights. Backtests 1, 2 and 4 never sell; weights drift with prices.</p><p><b>Layer out (Backtest 3):</b> each Monday, every holding's trendline <code>ln(Price) = a + b × ln(days since inception)</code> is refit on weekly closes up to that day only (needs 2 years of history). If <code>Price ÷ trendline − 1 &gt; 80%</code>, 20% of the holding is sold (no more than once every 4 weeks per name) and the proceeds buy the #1 name by Value score that week (deepest below its moving averages; price-only, no hindsight).</p>
    <p><b>Stats:</b> <i>Money-weighted return</i> = the yearly rate that makes every $135 deposit grow into the ending value (IRR, the right measure for DCA). <i>Time-weighted return</i> = yearly growth with deposits stripped out. <i>Volatility</i> = standard deviation of weekly returns × √52. <i>Max drawdown</i> = worst peak-to-trough fall of the time-weighted line. <i>Sharpe</i> = average weekly return over the risk-free rate ÷ its standard deviation × √52. <i>Sortino</i> = the same over downside volatility only.</p>
    <p><b>Prices:</b> dividend-adjusted closes where they exist (SPY, AVGO, NVDA, MU, MRVL, SILJ); gold via gold futures (GC=F). In Backtest 3, assets join once they have 30 days of prices (SPCX from July 2026; treasury companies from when they started holding coins).</p>
    <p><b>Limits:</b> starting in March 2020, three weeks before the COVID low, flatters every plan. Backtests 2–3 carry <i>survivorship bias</i>: its names were chosen in 2026, knowing which ones did well.</p>
  </div></details>
  <br><br><br><br><br>

<h3 class="pg-h">Backtest 2: Equal Weight, All <span class="nall">21</span> Names</h3>

  <div class="spec"><div class="sl">Period</div><div class="sv">Mar 2, 2020 – today</div><div class="sl">Contribution</div><div class="sv">$7,000 a year into a Roth IRA = ~$135 every Monday</div><div class="sl">Buys each week</div><div class="sv">equal split across every name with 30+ days of prices</div><div class="sl">Selling</div><div class="sv">never: buy and hold, no rebalancing</div></div>
  <div class="sim"><div class="sim-t">Backtest 2 <span id="sim5-res"></span></div>

    <details class="srcs"><summary>Week-by-week buys (click to open)</summary><div class="fbody"><table class="simlog"><thead><tr><th>Week of</th><th>Buying that week</th><th>Strategy</th><th>S&amp;P</th></tr></thead><tbody id="sim5-log"></tbody></table></div></details></div>

<h3 class="pg-h">Backtest 3: Layer In / Layer Out on the Regression Line</h3>
  <div class="bt-sub">Backtest 2's equal-weight DCA, plus a simple trim rule: when a holding runs 80% above its log-regression trendline, sell 20% of it and put the money into the current best buy</div>
  <div class="spec"><div class="sl">Period</div><div class="sv">Mar 2, 2020 – today</div><div class="sl">Contribution</div><div class="sv">$7,000 a year into a Roth IRA = ~$135 every Monday</div><div class="sl">Buys each week</div><div class="sv">equal split across every name with 30+ days of prices (layer in)</div><div class="sl">Selling</div><div class="sv"><b>layer out: price more than 80% above its trendline → sell 20% of that holding (at most once every 4 weeks per name); proceeds buy the #1 name by Value score that week</b></div></div>
  <div class="sim"><div class="sim-t">Backtest 3 <span id="simL-res"></span></div>

  <div class="spec"><div class="sl">Period</div><div class="sv">Mar 2, 2020 – today</div><div class="sl">Contribution</div><div class="sv">$7,000 a year into a Roth IRA = ~$135 every Monday</div><div class="sl">Buys each week</div><div class="sv">11.1% UUUU, 11.1% URNM, 11.1% Yellow Cake, 16.7% SILJ, 16.7% SLV, 33.3% BTC</div><div class="sl">Selling</div><div class="sv">never: buy and hold, no rebalancing</div></div>
  <div class="sim"><div class="sim-t">Backtest 4 <span id="simU-res"></span></div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var years = 3, tf = "D", logScale = true, DATA = null, charts = [];

  var TREASURY_T = ["MSTR", "MTPLF", "SPCX", "TSLA", "FWDI", "DFDV", "UPXI", "HSDT"];
  var PAIRS = [["ETH-USD", "BTC-USD"], ["BTC-USD", "GC=F"], ["FWDI", "SOL-USD"], ["MSTR", "BTC-USD"], ["SOL-USD", "BTC-USD"], ["SOL-USD", "DFDV"], ["AVGO", "MU"], ["AVGO", "NVDA"], ["NVDA", "MU"], ["MRVL", "AVGO"], ["MRVL", "NVDA"], ["TSLA", "SPCX"], ["SLV", "GC=F"], ["HG=F", "SLV"], ["SPY", "GC=F"], ["SOL-USD", "ETH-USD"]];
  var SHORT = {"BTC-USD": "BTC", "SOL-USD": "SOL", "BZ=F": "Brent", "GC=F": "Gold", "HG=F": "Copper", "ETH-USD": "ETH"};
  var sel = "BTC-USD";
  function sn(sym) { return SHORT[sym] || sym; }
  // ---------- paginated chart areas: one page at a time, tabs on top ----------
  function pgShow(tabs, pages, i) {
    pages.forEach(function (p, j) { p.classList.toggle("on", j === i); });
    tabs.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b, j) { b.classList.toggle("on", j === i); });
    pages[i].querySelectorAll("canvas").forEach(function (c) { var ch = Chart.getChart(c); if (ch) ch.resize(); });
  }
  function initPagers() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".fd .fdpager").forEach(function (pg) {
      if (pg.dataset.ready) return; pg.dataset.ready = 1;
      var pages = Array.prototype.slice.call(pg.children).filter(function (c) { return c.classList.contains("pg"); });
      var tabs = document.createElement("div"); tabs.className = "mp-tabs pg-tabs";
      tabs.innerHTML = pages.map(function (p) { return "<button>" + p.dataset.t + "</button>"; }).join("");
      pg.insertBefore(tabs, pg.firstChild);
      tabs.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b, i) { b.onclick = function () { pgShow(tabs, pages, i); }; });
      pgShow(tabs, pages, 0);
    });
  }
  var macroPage = 0;
  function pagerGrid(el) {   // the Economy cards: one card per page, remembering the open page across re-renders
    var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(el.children), tabs = document.getElementById(el.id + "-tabs");
    if (!tabs) { tabs = document.createElement("div"); tabs.id = el.id + "-tabs"; tabs.className = "mp-tabs pg-tabs"; el.parentNode.insertBefore(tabs, el); }
    tabs.innerHTML = cards.map(function (c) { return "<button>" + c.querySelector(".n").textContent + "</button>"; }).join("");
    el.classList.add("pg-grid"); cards.forEach(function (c) { c.classList.add("pg"); });
    tabs.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b, i) { b.onclick = function () { macroPage = i; pgShow(tabs, cards, i); }; });
    pgShow(tabs, cards, Math.min(macroPage, cards.length - 1));
  }
  // One color per ticker, used by every chart, pie, dot and swatch on the page
  var TCOL = {   // mostly vibrant red / blue / yellow, with pale versions of each, some orange and shades of green
    "BTC-USD": "#f5b700", "MSTR": "#e09a00", "MTPLF": "#fbd96b", "GC=F": "#f7c948",          // yellows (bitcoin, gold)
    "SOL-USD": "#1f5fd6", "FWDI": "#2f6fe8", "UPXI": "#6a9cf0", "DFDV": "#9fc0f5", "HSDT": "#4a86e8", "ETH-USD": "#3b4fc4",   // blues (solana)
    "TSLA": "#e02d2d", "SPCX": "#f08a8a", "MP": "#b8232b",                                                   // reds
    "HG=F": "#f07c1b", "CPER": "#f5a25c",                                                                      // oranges (copper)
    "NVDA": "#3fa34d", "AVGO": "#1f7a4d", "MU": "#7cc48a", "MRVL": "#2bb39a", "UUUU": "#8cc63e", "URNM": "#5a9a2a", "YCA": "#c3e08a",   // greens
    "SLV": "#a9b4c2", "SI=F": "#8795a8", "SILJ": "#c9d3e0", "SPY": "#1d2b4f" };
  function tc(k) { if (TCOL[k]) return TCOL[k]; var h = 0; for (var i = 0; i < k.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + k.charCodeAt(i)) % 360; return "hsl(" + h + ",55%,48%)"; }

  function dot(k) { return '<span class="tdot" style="background:' + tc(k) + '"></span>'; }
  function ratio(a, b) {           // a / b on the dates both traded
    var m = {}; DATA.prices[b].points.forEach(function (p) { m[p[0]] = p[1]; });
    return DATA.prices[a].points.filter(function (p) { return m[p[0]]; }).map(function (p) { return [p[0], +(p[1] / m[p[0]]).toPrecision(5)]; });
  }
  var fmtMoney = function (v) { return v >= 1000 ? "$" + v.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 0}) : "$" + v.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: v < 10 ? 3 : 2}); };
  var MACRO_FMT = {
    cpi_yoy: function (v) { return v.toFixed(1) + "%"; }, cpi_cum: function (v) { return "+" + v.toFixed(1) + "%"; }, unrate: function (v) { return v.toFixed(1) + "%"; },
    t10y2y: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + " pts"; }, debt_gdp: function (v) { return v.toFixed(1) + "%"; },
    m2: function (v) { return "$" + v.toFixed(2) + "T"; }, debt: function (v) { return "$" + v.toFixed(2) + "T"; },
    real_gdp: function (v) { return "$" + v.toFixed(2) + "T"; },
    payrolls: function (v) { return (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + Math.round(v).toLocaleString() + "K"; },
    fedfunds: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + "%"; }, dgs10: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + "%"; },
    dgs30: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + "%"; }, dgs2: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2) + "%"; }, shadow: function (v) { return "~" + v.toFixed(1) + "%"; },
    walcl: function (v) { return "$" + v.toFixed(2) + "T"; }, icsa: function (v) { return Math.round(v) + "K"; },
    sahm: function (v) { return v.toFixed(2); }
  };
  function cut(points, macro) {
    var y = macro && years && years < 1 ? 1 : years;   // economy charts are monthly/weekly data: show at least 1 year
    if (!y) return points;
    var d = new Date(points[points.length - 1][0]);
    if (y === 0.02) d.setDate(d.getDate() - 7);          // 1 week
    else if (y === 0.08) d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - 1);   // 1 month
    else d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() - y);

    return points.filter(function (p) { return p[0] >= s; });
  }
  // Weekly / monthly timeframe: keep the last value in each week (Mon-Sun) or month

    if (tf === "D") return points;

      if (k === key) out[out.length - 1] = p; else { out.push(p); key = k; }
    });
    return out;
  }
  function pctChange(points, daysBack) {

    var s = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10), base = null;
    for (var i = points.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (points[i][0] <= s) { base = points[i]; break; } }
    return base ? (last[1] / base[1] - 1) * 100 : null;
  }
  function chg(p) { return p == null ? "" : '<span class="' + (p >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + '">' + (p >= 0 ? "+" : "") + p.toFixed(1) + "%</span>"; }
  function card(el, id, title, value, note) {
    var c = document.createElement("div"); c.className = "card";
    c.innerHTML = '<div class="t"><span class="n">' + title + '</span><span class="v">' + value + '</span></div><div class="c">' + note + '</div><canvas id="' + id + '"></canvas>';
    el.appendChild(c); return document.getElementById(id);
  }
  function draw(canvas, points, opts) {
    var pts = resample(cut(points, opts.macro));
    var bar = opts.bar, color = opts.color || "#3d6fd6";
    return new Chart(canvas, {
      type: bar ? "bar" : "line",
      data: { labels: pts.map(function (p) { return p[0]; }),
              datasets: [{ data: pts.map(function (p) { return p[1]; }), borderColor: color, borderWidth: 1.6, pointRadius: 0, tension: 0.1,
                           backgroundColor: bar ? pts.map(function (p) { return p[1] >= 0 ? "#a8c5f7" : "#e07a7a"; }) : (opts.fill || "rgba(61,111,214,0.08)"), fill: !bar }] },
      options: {
        animation: false, responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false },
        plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function (c) { return opts.fmt(c.parsed.y); } } } },
        scales: {
          x: { ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 5, maxRotation: 0, color: "#6b7686", font: { size: 10 }, callback: function (v) { var l = this.getLabelForValue(v); return years && years < 1 && !opts.macro ? l.slice(5) : l.slice(0, years && years <= 3 ? 7 : 4); } }, grid: { display: false } },
          y: { type: opts.log ? "logarithmic" : "linear", position: "right", ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 5, color: "#6b7686", font: { size: 10 },
               callback: function (v) { return opts.axis ? opts.axis(v) : v; } }, grid: { color: "#f0f2f6" } }
        }
      }
    });
  }
  function render() {
    charts.forEach(function (c) { c.destroy(); }); charts = [];
    var P = document.getElementById("fd-prices"), M = document.getElementById("fd-macro");
    P.innerHTML = ""; M.innerHTML = "";
    FEATURED.forEach(function (sym, i) {
      var s = DATA.prices[sym], pts = s.points, last = pts[pts.length - 1];
      var cv = card(P, "p" + i, s.name, fmtMoney(last[1]), "1D " + chg(pctChange(pts, 1)) + " &nbsp; 1Y " + chg(pctChange(pts, 365)) + " &nbsp; as of " + last[0]);
      charts.push(draw(cv, pts, { log: logScale, fmt: fmtMoney, color: tc(sym), fill: tca(sym, 0.08), axis: function (v) { return v >= 1000 ? "$" + (v / 1000).toFixed(v >= 10000 ? 0 : 1) + "k" : "$" + v; } }));
    });
    // Explorer: one chart, click between tickers and pairs
    var ex = document.createElement("div"); ex.className = "card explorer";
    var isPair = sel.indexOf("/") > 0, pts, title, val, note, f;
    if (isPair) {

      note = "How many " + sn(ab[1]) + " one " + sn(ab[0]) + " buys. Rising = " + sn(ab[0]) + " outperforming. 1Y " + chg(pctChange(pts, 365));
    } else {

      note = "1D " + chg(pctChange(pts, 1)) + " &nbsp; 1Y " + chg(pctChange(pts, 365)) + " &nbsp; as of " + pts[pts.length - 1][0];
    }
    val = f(pts[pts.length - 1][1]);
    ex.innerHTML = '<div class="t"><span class="n">' + title + '</span><span class="v">' + val + '</span></div><div class="c">' + note + '</div>' +
      '<div class="tabs"><span class="lab">Tickers</span>' + SINGLES.map(function (k) { return '<button data-k="' + k + '"' + (k === sel ? ' class="on"' : '') + '>' + sn(k) + '</button>'; }).join("") + '</div>' +
      '<div class="tabs"><span class="lab">Pairs</span>' + PAIRS.map(function (p) { var k = p[0] + "/" + p[1]; return '<button class="pair' + (k === sel ? ' on' : '') + '" data-k="' + k + '">' + sn(p[0]) + "/" + sn(p[1]) + '</button>'; }).join("") + '</div>' +
      '<div class="tabs"><span class="lab">Treasury companies</span>' + TREASURY_T.filter(function (k) { return DATA.prices[k]; }).map(function (k) { return '<button data-k="' + k + '"' + (k === sel ? ' class="on"' : '') + '>' + sn(k) + '</button>'; }).join("") + '</div>' +
      '<canvas id="ex"></canvas>';
    P.appendChild(ex);
    ex.querySelectorAll("button[data-k]").forEach(function (b) { b.onclick = function () { sel = b.dataset.k; render(); }; });
    charts.push(draw(document.getElementById("ex"), pts, { log: logScale, fmt: f, color: isPair ? "#d9736f" : tc(sel), fill: isPair ? "rgba(224,122,122,0.08)" : tca(sel, 0.08), axis: isPair ? function (v) { return (+v).toPrecision(3); } : function (v) { return v >= 1000 ? "$" + (v / 1000).toFixed(v >= 10000 ? 0 : 1) + "k" : "$" + v; } }));
    perfChart(P);

    var ORDER = ["t10y2y", "debt_gdp", "cpi_cum", "cpi_yoy", "shadow", "fedfunds", "walcl", "unrate", "icsa", "payrolls", "real_gdp", "m2", "debt", "dgs10", "dgs30", "dgs2"];
    ORDER.filter(function (k) { return DATA.macro[k]; }).forEach(function (k, i) {
      var s = DATA.macro[k], pts = s.points, last = pts[pts.length - 1], f = MACRO_FMT[k] || function (v) { return v; };
      var cv = card(M, "m" + i, s.name, f(last[1]), s.unit + " &nbsp;·&nbsp; latest " + last[0]);
      var warm = ["fedfunds", "dgs10", "dgs30", "dgs2", "cpi_yoy", "cpi_cum", "shadow", "unrate", "icsa", "debt", "debt_gdp"].indexOf(k) >= 0;   // stress gauges in faded red
      if (s.band) {   // estimate range: official CPI + (7 - band) to CPI + 7
        var lo = pts.map(function (p) { return [p[0], +(p[1] - s.band).toFixed(2)]; });
        cv.parentNode.querySelector(".v").textContent = "~" + (last[1] - s.band).toFixed(1) + "–" + last[1].toFixed(1) + "%";
        var ch = draw(cv, lo, { macro: true, fmt: f, axis: null, color: "#d9736f", fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0)" });
        var hp = resample(cut(pts, true)); ch.data.datasets[0].fill = false;
        ch.data.datasets.push({ data: hp.map(function (p) { return p[1]; }), borderColor: "#d9736f", borderWidth: 1.6, pointRadius: 0, tension: 0.1, fill: "-1", backgroundColor: "rgba(224,122,122,0.18)" });
        ch.options.plugins.tooltip.callbacks.label = function (c) { return (c.datasetIndex ? "CPI + 7: " : "CPI + 4: ") + c.parsed.y.toFixed(1) + "%"; };
        ch.update(); charts.push(ch); return;
      }
      charts.push(draw(cv, pts, { macro: true, bar: k === "payrolls", fmt: f, axis: null, color: warm ? "#d9736f" : "#3d6fd6", fill: warm ? "rgba(224,122,122,0.07)" : "rgba(61,111,214,0.08)" }));
    });
    pagerGrid(M);
  }
  // Performance: every ticker vs the S&P 500 and the 10-year Treasury, growth of $1 over the last 5 years (log scale)
  // colors by where each line ends: above the S&P = dark to light green, between the S&P and the 10-year = yellow, below the 10-year = light to dark red
  function mix(a, b, t) { return "rgb(" + a.map(function (x, i) { return Math.round(x + (b[i] - x) * t); }).join(",") + ")"; }
  var endLabels = { id: "endLabels", afterDatasetsDraw: function (ch) {
    var ctx = ch.ctx, A = ch.chartArea, items = [], colX = A.right + 34;

      for (var k = ds.data.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) if (ds.data[k] != null) {
        var pt = meta.data[k], off = pt.y > A.bottom;
        items.push({ y0: Math.min(pt.y, A.bottom), x0: pt.x, v: ds.data[k], t: ds.label, c: ds.borderColor, pin: ds.pin }); break; } });
    ctx.save(); ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    // S&P 500 and 10-year: labelled right on their own lines
    items.filter(function (it) { return it.pin; }).forEach(function (it) {
      ctx.font = "700 11px system-ui,sans-serif"; var w = ctx.measureText(it.t).width;
      ctx.fillStyle = it.c; ctx.fillText(it.t, it.x0 - w - 7, it.y0 + (it.t === "S&P 500" ? -10 : 10));
    });
    // everything else: a column in top-to-bottom order, each joined to its line by a thin connector
    var rest = items.filter(function (it) { return !it.pin; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.v - a.v; });
    var step = rest.length > 1 ? Math.max(11, (A.bottom - A.top) / (rest.length - 1)) : 0;
    rest.forEach(function (it, n) {
      var y = A.top + n * step;
      ctx.strokeStyle = it.c; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55; ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(it.x0 + 2, it.y0); ctx.lineTo(A.right + 8, it.y0); ctx.lineTo(colX - 4, y); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.font = "600 10.5px system-ui,sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = it.c; ctx.fillText(it.t, colX, y);
    });
    ctx.restore();
  } };
  function smoothLog(v, h) {   // centered moving average of log values; the window shrinks at the ends so the last point stays exact
    return v.map(function (x, i) {
      if (x == null) return null;
      var w = Math.min(h, i, v.length - 1 - i), s = 0, n = 0;
      for (var j = i - w; j <= i + w; j++) if (v[j] != null) { s += Math.log(v[j]); n++; }
      return Math.exp(s / n);
    });
  }
  function perfChart(P) {
    var spy = DATA.prices["SPY"]; if (!spy) return;
    var s0 = "2020-04-01";
    var base = resampleW(spy.points.filter(function (p) { return p[0] >= s0; }));
    var dates = base.map(function (p) { return p[0]; });
    function onDates(points) {   // last close on or before each date; null before the series starts
      var out = [], i = 0, last = null;
      dates.forEach(function (d) { while (i < points.length && points[i][0] <= d) { last = points[i][1]; i++; } out.push(last); });
      return out;
    }

    function line(st, r) { return "Total Sharpe ratio: <b>" + st.sh.toFixed(2) + "</b> &nbsp;·&nbsp; Median expected return to 2030: <b>" + pct(r) + "</b>"; }
    document.getElementById("pf-tot3").innerHTML = "Core Portfolio — " + line(core, ret(rmA, Wcore)) + "<br>Highest-Sharpe mix of all Markets tickers — " + line(sA, ret(rmA, optA.w));
    (function () {   // one-line recommendation: move the Growth Portfolio toward its highest-Sharpe mix
      var o = hn.map(function (k, i) { return { k: k, n: optH.w[i] * 100, c: W[i] * 100 }; }).filter(function (x) { return x.n >= 0.5 || x.c >= 0.5; })
        .sort(function (a, b) { return b.n - a.n; });
      document.getElementById("fd-rec").innerHTML = '<div class="bxt">Recommendation</div>' + o.map(function (x) {
        var d = x.n - x.c, a = d > 1 ? '<span class="up">&uarr;</span>' : d < -1 ? '<span class="dn">&darr;</span>' : '<span class="eq">=</span>';
        return sn(x.k) + " " + Math.round(x.n) + "% " + a; }).join(" &nbsp;·&nbsp; ") + " &nbsp;(highest-Sharpe mix: " + curH.sh.toFixed(2) + " &rarr; " + sH.sh.toFixed(2) + ")";
    })();
    document.getElementById("pf-tot1").innerHTML = "Growth Portfolio — " + line(curH, ret(rmH, W)) + "<br>Highest-Sharpe mix of Growth Portfolio holdings — " + line(sH, ret(rmH, optH.w));
    document.getElementById("pf-tot2").innerHTML = "Growth Portfolio — " + line(curA, ret(rmA, Wfull)) + "<br>Highest-Sharpe mix of all Markets tickers — " + line(sA, ret(rmA, optA.w));
  }

  var PERSONAL_ON = true;
  function targetsView() {   // DATA.targets, or a copy without the personal predictions when the toggle is off
    var T = DATA.targets; if (PERSONAL_ON || !T) return T;
    var out = {}; Object.keys(T).forEach(function (k) { var t = T[k], c = Object.assign({}, t);
      if (t.long) { var oth = t.long.filter(function (x) { return x.by !== "Personal predictions"; });
        if (oth.length !== t.long.length && oth.length) { var v = oth.map(function (x) { return x.v; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; }), m = v.length >> 1;
          c.long = oth; c.low = v[0]; c.high = v[v.length - 1]; c.n = v.length; c.base = v.length % 2 ? v[m] : (v[m - 1] + v[m]) / 2; } }
      if (t.personal) delete c.personal;
      out[k] = c; });
    return out;
  }
  function bestBuy() {
    var T = targetsView(), trow = {}; if (!T) return;
    var ASOF = DATA.targets_asof || "2026-09-28";   // sector targets are locked to prices on the date the targets were checked
    var ta = document.getElementById("tgt-asof"); if (ta) ta.textContent = ASOF;
    (DATA.treasury ? DATA.treasury.rows : []).forEach(function (r) { trow[r.t] = r; });
    var y30 = yearsTo(2030), rows = [], skipped = [];
    var SECTOR_NAME = { "URANIUM": "uranium", "SLV": "silver", "COMMOD": "uranium, silver, gold & copper avg" };
    function spotAsof(k) { return k === "URANIUM" ? T.URANIUM.spot : pxOn(T[k].of || k, ASOF); }
    function mult(k) { var t = T[k], s = spotAsof(k); return { lo: t.low / s, base: t.base / s, hi: t.high / s, n: t.n }; }
    function sector(sk) {   // 2030 target as a multiple of the price on the target date
      if (sk !== "COMMOD") return mult(sk);   // (n below = number of sector outlooks averaged, for COMMOD)
      var ms = ["URANIUM", "SLV", "GC=F", "CPER"].map(function (k) { var m = mult(k), d = T[k].x2 ? 2 : 1; return { lo: m.lo / d, base: m.base / d, hi: m.hi / d, n: m.n }; }), avg = function (f) { return ms.reduce(function (s, m) { return s + f(m); }, 0) / ms.length; };
      return { lo: avg(function (m) { return m.lo; }), base: avg(function (m) { return m.base; }), hi: avg(function (m) { return m.hi; }), n: ms.length + " outlooks" };
    }
    var M30 = (Date.parse("2030-12-31T00:00:00Z") - Date.now()) / 2.6298e9;   // months to end-2030
    function to12(v, hd, px, base) {   // any ~1-year target, restated as exactly 12 months from today
      var m = (Date.parse(hd + "T00:00:00Z") - Date.now()) / 2.6298e9; if (!(m > 0.5)) return null;   // expired
      return m >= 12 ? px * Math.pow(v / px, 12 / m) : v * Math.pow(1.04, (12 - m) / 12);   // short targets carried to 12 months at ~T-bill rate
    }
    bestUniverse().forEach(function (k) {
      var t = T[k]; if (!t) { skipped.push(k); return; }
      var px = lastPx(k), row = { k: k, px: px, kind: t.kind, n: t.n, nav1: null, note: "" }, f = 1;
      if (t.kind === "direct") { row.lo = t.low; row.base = t.base; row.hi = t.high; }
      else if (t.kind === "proxy") { f = px / lastPx(t.of); row.lo = t.low * f; row.base = t.base * f; row.hi = t.high * f; }
      else if (t.kind === "sector") { var s = sector(t.sector), anc = pxOn(k, ASOF); row.lo = s.lo * anc; row.base = s.base * anc; row.hi = s.hi * anc; row.n = s.n; row.note = "via " + SECTOR_NAME[t.sector] + " 2030 outlook"; }
      else if (t.kind === "nav") {   // EV method: coin target x coins x EV-mNAV (halfway to 1.0x, log terms), minus net debt, per share
        var tr = trow[k], c = T[t.coin]; if (!tr || !tr.shares) { skipped.push(k); return; }
        var qty = netQty(tr), sh = tr.shares, cp = lastPx(t.coin), ND = (tr.debt || 0) + (tr.pref || 0) - (tr.cash || 0);
        var mev = (px * sh + ND) / (qty * cp), m30 = Math.sqrt(Math.max(mev, 0.05));
        var cb = c.base;
        if (t.personal) {   // avoid counting the personal view twice: the NAV leg uses the other BTC forecasters only
          var oth = (c.long || []).filter(function (x) { return x.by !== "Personal predictions"; }).map(function (x) { return x.v; });
          if (oth.length) cb = oth.reduce(function (a2, b2) { return a2 + b2; }, 0) / oth.length;
        }
        var eq = function (cv) { return Math.max(0.01 * px, (cv * qty * m30 - ND) / sh); };
        row.lo = eq(c.low); row.base = eq(cb); row.hi = eq(c.high); row.n = c.n;
        row.note = "from " + sn(t.coin) + " 2030 targets; EV-mNAV " + mev.toFixed(2) + "x now (incl. debt), assumed " + m30.toFixed(2) + "x in 2030";
        row.nav1 = { coin: sn(t.coin), now: (px * sh + ND) / qty, tgt: Math.max(0, (c.base * qty - ND) / sh), cbase: c.base };
        if (t.personal) {   // Personal prediction counts for 50%, the EV-derived target the other 50%
          row.base = 0.5 * t.personal.v + 0.5 * row.base; row.lo = Math.min(row.lo, t.personal.v); row.hi = Math.max(row.hi, t.personal.v); row.n += 1;
          row.note += "; median = 50% personal prediction ($" + t.personal.v.toLocaleString("en-US") + ") + 50% EV-derived";
        }
      }
      // 12-month return: every ~1-year target restated to exactly 12 months out, then averaged
      var x2 = t.x2 ? 2 : 1, srcs = t.cons ? [{ v: t.cons.avg * x2, hd: t.cons.hd }] : (t.short || []).map(function (s) { return { v: s.v * f * x2, hd: s.hd }; });
      var v12 = srcs.map(function (s) { return s.hd ? to12(s.v, s.hd, px, row.base) : null; }).filter(function (x) { return x != null && isFinite(x); });
      row.r12 = v12.length ? v12.reduce(function (s2, x) { return s2 + x; }, 0) / v12.length / px - 1 : null; row.n12 = t.cons ? t.cons.n : v12.length;
      // median target as a function of prices on any day (used by the weekly backtests)
      if (t.kind === "direct") GROWTH_FN[k] = function (P) { return t.base; };
      else if (t.kind === "proxy") GROWTH_FN[k] = function (P) { return t.base * P(k) / P(t.of); };
      else if (t.kind === "sector") { var sb = row.base; GROWTH_FN[k] = function (P) { return sb; }; }
      else if (t.kind === "nav") { (function (tr2, coin, cbg, pv) { var ND2 = (tr2.debt || 0) + (tr2.pref || 0) - (tr2.cash || 0);
        GROWTH_FN[k] = function (P) { var m2 = Math.max((P(k) * tr2.shares + ND2) / (tr2.qty * P(coin)), 0.05), g = Math.max(0.01 * P(k), (cbg * tr2.qty * Math.sqrt(m2) - ND2) / tr2.shares); return pv ? 0.5 * pv + 0.5 * g : g; };
      })({ shares: trow[k].shares, qty: netQty(trow[k]), debt: trow[k].debt, pref: trow[k].pref, cash: trow[k].cash }, t.coin, cb, t.personal ? t.personal.v : null); }
      row.r30 = row.base / px - 1; row.yr = Math.pow(row.base / px, 1 / y30) - 1;
      rows.push(row);
    });

      ps.innerHTML = "<b>Personal predictions " + (PERSONAL_ON ? "ON" : "OFF") + "</b> · 2030 medians: " + ["BTC-USD", "SOL-USD", "TSLA", "MSTR"].filter(function (k) { return by[k]; })
        .map(function (k) { return sn(k) + " " + (by[k] >= 1000 ? "$" + Math.round(by[k]).toLocaleString("en-US") : "$" + by[k].toFixed(2)); }).join(" · "); }
    rows.forEach(function (r, i) { r.t = rows.length > 1 ? 1 - i / (rows.length - 1) : 1; });
    function rt(v) { return (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + Math.round(v * 100).toLocaleString("en-US") + "%"; }
    function m(v) { return v >= 1000 ? money(v) : "$" + v.toPrecision(v < 1 ? 3 : 4); }
    if (bestChart) bestChart.destroy();
    bestChart = barChart(document.getElementById("best-chart"), rows, rows.map(function (r) { return Math.round(r.yr * 1000) / 10; }),
      function (r) { return "Median 2030 target " + m(r.base) + " = " + rt(r.r30) + " total (" + (r.yr * 100).toFixed(1) + "% a year)" +
        (r.r12 != null ? "; next 12 months " + rt(r.r12) : ""); },
      { ticks: { callback: function (v) { return v + "%"; }, color: "#6b7686", font: { size: 10 } }, title: { display: true, text: "CAGR to the median 2030 target", color: "#6b7686", font: { size: 11 } } });
    // table
    function gy(t) { t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t)); var a = [252, 236, 178], b = [183, 226, 196];

    function tp(v, px) { var g = v / px - 1; return m(v) + "<small>" + (g >= 0 ? "+" : "") + Math.round(g * 100).toLocaleString("en-US") + "%</small>"; }
